headline: Krško Could Build a 200-Meter-Tall Cooling Tower for JEK 2
summary: As part of procedures for a second unit at the Krško nuclear plant, GEN Energija received study results on transporting equipment and possible cooling methods. A 200-metre cooling tower is among the options.
why: GEN Energija operates the Krško nuclear plant in Slovenia, and new nuclear capacity affects regional power supply and energy investment plans.
